storage_root: No stored morale scalar; derived from battle-side Units. Aura derives from server-synchronized Player ruler TowerId.

fields.name: derived_morale
fields.update_rule: min(3, floor(non_single_use_count/2)) computed each battle; no scalar write/reset
fields.combat_effect: initial signed accumulated damage only for exclusive aura

fields.name: player_ruler_position
fields.type: packed optional TowerId; low-bit presence, upper32 TowerId
fields.range: absent or world TowerId; exact server validity unknown
fields.update_rule: client func460 copies i64 from server PlayerInput, or writes i32 zero in another input branch; server writer unknown
fields.confidence: HIGH client layout; PARTIAL upstream semantics

fields.name: tower_aura
fields.update_rule: func448 when (tower_index XOR tick)&15==0: owner exists and ruler TowerId is same or neighbor =>1, else 0

fields.name: force_aura
fields.update_rule: func1791 copies Tower+45 on deployment; later reset/write coverage incomplete
fields.combat_effect: attacker-only aura selects positive M(attacker); also movement progress effect
fields.confidence: HIGH for deployment; PARTIAL full lifetime

fields.name: battle_damage_initial
fields.update_rule: exclusive aura: +M(attacker), -M(defender), or 0; calculated after shield stripping
fields.combat_effect: initial accumulator supplied to unit-selection and damage loop
